name: GESWORK
description: Modular management software for French service companies (ops / productivity suite).

mentions.evidence: ~$3.7k MRR, 41 active subscriptions, ~$4.0k L30, ~$113k all-time, founded Feb 2024. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Most solo-plausible ops suite of the day — country-specific service software still underserved.

whyItPrints: Service SMBs need scheduling, docs, and billing in one place. Same founder also runs Valideo (field intervention reports, ~$3.7k MRR Stripe-verified).
whyThisMatters:
French software for service companies. You buy it as packs you assemble, not one giant suite you can't turn off. The modules they name are sales admin, payroll, and running jobs in the field. In the box: a cloud drive, a personal schedule, and chat between users. Computer or phone.

Then a client portal. The customer gets a space in the company's colors and can open their own quotes, invoices, equipment lists, and reports. "Where's my invoice" stops being an email to the owner. For a service firm the visit, the quote, and the bill are one job. The portal is how the customer sees that job.

You can try it free or book a demo. One note on the site thanks a guy named Vincent for help getting set up. That's a customer talking about onboarding, not a claim about how big the team is.

The same founder also runs Valideo, the field-report product, which has its own page here. Geswork's site doesn't lean on that. It leans on the packs, and on a place for the client to look up the paperwork.
